items.disposition: The literal orientation/phase vocabulary must be mapped to a declared source calculation before using the bodily rows. No generic east-half/west-half or signed elongation is silently selected.
Robbins interprets these as places and rulers. Record this as explanatory commentary rather than a numerical mixture formula.
Robbins identifies a perhaps-corrupt and otherwise unattested word. Preserve the English witness; no confident synonym/clinical measurement.

The III.11 note relates forward daily motion to orbital retrogression. The III.13 note describes advances versus retrogression and points back to ambiguity. The same source word must not receive a global positive-speed alias without resolution.
Hot/cold/moist/dry are the source constitutional categories. No psychometric personality or modern physiology equivalence is provided.
Robbins identifies the preceding disjunct setting place as sixth; his angular-luminary note refers to first/seventh, not indiscriminately all four angles. Preserve textual variants.
Positioned-against is not proof of a station. The translated eye-condition and/or nesting and aspect/cluster proximity lack fully specified numerical predicates.
Six descriptive groups are preserved without making six precise modern star coordinates or selecting whichever object fits an outcome.
The Mercury/Saturn relational clause and subsequent inherited conditions must remain explicit. No modern identity or medical classifier is admitted.
Quadrature is defined in a note, but near seasonal points, last degrees, and relevant aspect strengths are not numerically bounded here.
Leprosy, glaucoma, scurvy, black bile, sacred disease and other labels are source-era/translator vocabulary. No modern differential diagnosis is implied.
The chapter makes separate statements about visible disfigurement, pain, curability, aid, concealment and gains. Do not merge these into a single absent/present-health endpoint.
